info.description: AutoMuteUs API, served independently of Discord bot shards.
info.title: AutoMuteUs

post.description:
Shows a banner on every game status message until cleared. A critical notice also ends every
running game (unmuting everyone, recording the matches as aborted) and blocks /new while active.

get.description: Get all Discord commands that the bot implements
Get basic information about the bot

The settings every guild starts with, and what GET /guild/settings returns for a guild that never
changed anything. Clients compare against this to show which settings a guild has customised and to
offer a reset. Not guild-specific and not secret, so no authentication is required.
Bearer callers must supply guildID and receive only roomCode from the verified game snapshot. Basic Auth uses the legacy global lookup and returns connectCode too.
Get the current state of a running game. Bearer callers receive MemberGameState; platform Basic Auth receives the stored document.

200.description: Stored game state, using the bot's JSON representation

get.description:
Report whether the bot is currently a member of the given guild, based on the guild join and leave
events the bot has processed. Any member of the guild may ask.

Report whether the bot could post match summaries into a channel of the given guild: the channel
must exist and be visible to the bot, belong to the guild, be a text or announcement channel or a
thread in one, and grant the bot View Channel, Embed Links, and Send Messages (Send Messages in Threads
for a thread). The same checks are applied when PATCH /guild/settings changes
matchSummaryChannelID, so a client can validate before saving. Any member of the guild may ask.

501.description: The API is not configured with DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN

get.description:
The guild's text and announcement channels as the bot sees them, in Discord's display order with
their category, each marked with whether the bot could post match summaries there and, if not, why:
the same verdict GET /guild/channel gives for one channel and PATCH /guild/settings applies on save.
Threads are not listed; one can still be set by ID. Channel names can be private, so this requires
the same permission as changing settings: the guild owner, or Administrator or Manage Server.

403.description: The caller may not change this guild's settings

404.description: The bot is not in this guild

501.description: The API is not configured with DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN

get.description: Get the premium status for a given guild

The guild's roles as the bot sees them, in Discord's display order and without @everyone, so a client
can offer a picker for bot operator roles and show names instead of IDs. PATCH /guild/settings rejects a
permissionRoleIDs entry that is not one of these. Any member of the guild may ask.

404.description: The bot is not in this guild

501.description: The API is not configured with DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN

get.description: Get the settings for a given guild. Guilds that never changed a setting get the defaults.

ETag.description: Version of the stored settings, for If-Match on PATCH

patch.description:
Change settings for a guild. The body is a JSON object with any subset of the fields returned by GET
/guild/settings; fields that are present replace the stored value and fields that are absent keep it.
Voice rule and delay rows are replaced whole, so a row must list every entry. Unknown fields, null
values, and values outside the ranges the /settings slash command accepts are rejected without saving.
Requires the guild owner or the Discord Administrator or Manage Server permission. Changing a
premium-only setting
(match summary options, auto refresh, leaderboard options, spectator muting, room code display) on a
guild without premium is refused with 403 listing those fields. A new matchSummaryChannelID must pass
the same checks as GET /guild/channel: visible to the bot, in this guild, text-capable, and granting
the bot View Channel, Send Messages, and Embed Links. A changed permissionRoleIDs list must name roles of
this guild (see GET /guild/roles) when the API has bot credentials.

parameters.description: ETag from a previous GET or PATCH; the write is refused with 412 if the settings changed since
parameters.name: If-Match

200.description: The stored settings after the change

ETag.description: Version of the stored settings after the change

409.description: Settings were changed concurrently; reload and retry

412.description: If-Match did not match the stored version

501.description: Summary channel changes need DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN on the API

get.description:
The guild statistics page in one document. Every guild gets the summary (games played and each
side's wins); guilds with active premium also get the leaderboards the /stats guild slash command
shows, five entries per board, honouring the guild's leaderboard minimum. User IDs are resolved to the
names the bot last cached where available. Responses are built at most once a minute per guild.

name.description:
Name is the channel name without the leading '#'. Omitted when the channel is not in the requested guild,
so a caller cannot use this route to learn channel names in guilds it shares with the bot but not with us.

crewmateGames.description: CrewmateGames is how many games the player was a crewmate in, the denominator of Rate.

firstDeaths.description: FirstDeaths is how many games this player was the first to die in.

category.description: Category is the name of the parent category, empty for a channel at the top level.

ok.description: Problems is empty exactly when OK is true; each entry is a sentence a client can show for the channel.

type.description:
Type is Discord's channel type: 0 for a text channel, 5 for an announcement channel. Threads are never
listed; Discord does not include them in a guild's channel list.

bestImpostorDuo.description:
The duo boards rank pairs of players who shared a role in a game. Each pair appears once, lower user ID
first. Best is highest winrate first; worst is lowest first.

firstTarget.description: FirstTarget ranks players by how often they were the first to die.

killedBy.description:
KilledBy ranks crewmate and impostor pairs by how often the crewmate died with that impostor in the game.
The game never reports who made a kill, so a death counts against every impostor of that game.

minGames.description:
MinGames is the guild's leaderboard minimum: the games a player or crewmate duo needs to be ranked by
rate. The impostor duo boards use a fixed floor of two shared games instead.

mostGames.description: MostGames ranks players by games recorded, with no minimum.

winrate.description: Winrate ranks players by winrate across both roles.

color.description: Color is Discord's integer RGB value; zero means the role has no colour.

managed.description: Managed roles belong to an integration or bot and cannot be given to members by hand.

position.description: Position is Discord's display order; higher is listed first.

generatedAt.description: GeneratedAt is the Unix time the rollup was built; responses may be served from a short cache.

leaderboards.description: Leaderboards is omitted for guilds whose premium is free or expired.

players.description:
Players maps every user ID named in the leaderboards to a name and picture, resolved through Discord with
the bot's credentials or from the names the bot cached. IDs nothing knows are absent and the page shows
the ID itself.

premium.description:
Premium is the guild's premium status the rollup was built under, so the page can explain a missing
leaderboards section without a second request.

deaths.description: Deaths is how many of the shared games the crewmate died in.

games.description: Games is how many games the two shared as crewmate and impostor, the denominator of Rate.

message.example: Database maintenance in progress; expect some lag.

severity.description: Severity is warning or critical. Critical ends every running game and blocks new ones.

avatar.description:
Avatar is a Discord CDN image URL: the user's avatar for this guild, else their global avatar, else the
default Discord assigns them. Always set when the profile was resolved through Discord.

globalName.description: GlobalName is the display name the user chose for all of Discord, if any.

nickname.description: Nickname is the user's name in this guild, if they set one.

default_permission.description: NOTE: DefaultPermission will be soon deprecated. Use DefaultMemberPermissions and DMPermission instead.

delays.description: maps from origin->new phases, with the integer number of seconds for the delay

DiscordBearer.description: Discord OAuth access token: Bearer <token>; requires identify and guilds.
